summary: PO 2019 §7: 145 ECTS of compulsory modules (PBP 1 to PBP 20, including the physics seminar and the advanced lab), at least 23 ECTS of electives from one mixed pool (physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, electrical engineering and mathematics, including 6 ECTS of additive key competencies and usually the 8-ECTS Berufspraktikum, which may be replaced), and the 12-ECTS thesis. The elective minimum is enforced as 23 ECTS.

categories.name: Elective modules
categories.note: At least 23 ECTS in total, including 6 ECTS additive key competencies (PBS) and usually the 8-ECTS Berufspraktikum, which may be replaced by other electives.
